title: These Robotic Arms Are Powered by Algae. Watch How They Move

claims.claim: Delft University of Technology's research team developed a soft robotic arm colonized by algae on its surface.

evidence.quote: a research team at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands has developed a soft robotic arm colonized by algae on its surface
now a research team at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands has developed a soft robotic arm colonized by algae on its surface

claims.claim: Marie-Eve Aubin-Tam led the research at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands.

evidence.quote: “We didn’t start with a specific application. Our goal has always been to bring the research of living materials to new levels,” Marie-Eve Aubin-Tam, who led the research, explained in a press release.

now a research team at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands has developed a soft robotic arm colonized by algae on its surface... “We didn’t start with a specific application. Our goal has always been to bring the research of living materials to new levels,” Marie-Eve Aubin-Tam, who led the research, explained

claims.claim: The tiny robot arms are about three-quarters of an inch long and about as thick as a credit card.

evidence.quote: The tiny robot arms—about three-quarters of an inch long and about as thick as a credit card—are constructed of two layers of hydrogel that the algal cells live on.
The tiny robot arms—about three-quarters of an inch long and about as thick as a credit card—are constructed of two layers of hydrogel

claims.claim: The robot arms are constructed of two layers of hydrogel that the algal cells live on.

evidence.quote: are constructed of two layers of hydrogel that the algal cells live on.

claims.claim: In acidic conditions between pH 3 and 7, the hydrogel layer was approximately 37 percent of its original weight, but it had quadruple its original weight at pH 11.

evidence.quote: In acidic conditions, such as between pH 3 and 7, the layer was approximately 37 percent of its original weight, but it had quadruple its original weight at pH 11.

claims.claim: The chemical shift begins about 20 seconds after light is applied and about 10 seconds after it becomes dark.

evidence.quote: The chemical shift begins quickly, about 20 seconds after light is applied and about 10 seconds after it becomes dark

claims.claim: The research team constructed a four-fingered gripper that closes when exposed to light and successfully grasped and lifted a hollow metal sphere.

evidence.quote: One was a four-fingered gripper that closes when exposed to light. It successfully grasped and lifted a hollow metal sphere
One was a four-fingered gripper that closes when exposed to light. It successfully grasped and lifted a hollow metal sphere, releasing it when the light was turned off.

claims.claim: This story originally appeared on WIRED Japan and has been translated from Japanese.

evidence.quote: This story originally appeared on WIRED Japan and has been translated from Japanese.
